title: Above-ground sanitary drainage and vent pipe.
officialText:
Above-ground soil, waste and vent pipe shall conform to one of the
standards listed in Table 702.1.
TABLE 702.1
ABOVE-GROUND DRAINAGE AND VENT PIPE
MATERIAL STANDARD

(ABS) plastic pipe in IPS

core or composite walla

ASTM A 74;

(Type K, L) ASTM B 251; ASTM B 306
Ductile iron AWWA C15 1
Galvanized steel pipe ASTM A 53
Glass pipe ASTM C 1053
High silicon cast iron ASTM A 518 A/518 M

Polyolefin pipea
CAN/CSA-B 181.3
Polyvinyl chloride (PVC)
plastic pipe in IPS diameters,
including Schedule 40, DR 22 ASTM D 2665; ASTM F 891;
(PS 200), and DR 24 (PS ASTM F 1488; CSA B181.2
140); with a solid, cellular

pipe with a 3.25-inch O.D. and a

solid, cellular core or composite
walla

a. Limited to residential buildings five stories or less in height.
